infoText.text: This adapter uses the Rain Bird IQ4 Cloud API for MQTT controllers (ESP-TM2). You must authenticate using the iq4-cli tool first.

cliPath.label: Path to iq4-cli binary
cliPath.help: Full path to the iq4-cli executable. Default: ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/rainbird-iq4/iq4-cli

controllerId.label: Controller ID (optional)
controllerId.help: Leave empty to auto-detect the first controller in your account

pollinterval.label: Poll interval (ms)
pollinterval.help: How often to update controller status (minimum 5000ms)

authInfo.text:
Authentication Setup:
1. Install iq4-cli: cd ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/rainbird-iq4 && go build -o iq4-cli .
2. Login: ./iq4-cli login YOUR_USERNAME YOUR_PASSWORD
3. Restart adapter

constraintInfo.text: ⚠️ Important: ESP-TM2 controllers only accept start times in 15-minute intervals (:00, :15, :30, :45). Other times will be ignored.
